Asset type: transparent RPG village-help quest medal icon, square canvas.
Primary request: one large round gold medal awarded by grateful villagers. Central embossed emblem: two simple clasped helping hands with a tiny heart above them, encircled by a simple wreath. Small teal ribbon tab behind the upper edge. Friendly fantasy village identity, clearly distinct from a normal gold currency coin.
Style: match the provided three canonical game equipment references ONLY for their coarse pixel cluster art, dark outlines and flat metallic shading. Native 128x128 logical pixel composition, about 24-32 colors, 1 logical pixel dark brown outline, 3-4 flat shades per material, big bold readable shapes. No pumpkins, ghosts or Halloween motifs. Icon must read at 24px and 48px.
Composition: centered medal occupies 84% of square; face-on, circular, not tilted, no chain. True alpha outside medal. No text, lettering, numerals, background, card, floor, broad glow, micro filigree, smooth gradients, photographic or painted texture.

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: illustrated resizable wooden quest noticeboard panel background for a fantasy village game UI.
Primary request: straight-on view of an empty wooden village notice board. Rich warm walnut wood with a chunky carved wooden frame, subtle hand-painted wood grain, slightly worn edges, four small dark iron corner fasteners. Welcoming storybook fantasy RPG UI, matching warm ivory parchment letter stationery. No roof, stand, legs or surrounding environment.
Composition: square image nearly fills the canvas, genuine alpha transparency only outside its subtly irregular outer edge. Frame occupies outer 7% strip, corners confined to outer 10%, center 86% is flat dark warm wood planks, softly textured and low contrast so cream paper quest notices can be overlaid. Built for nine-slice scaling: straight repeatable edge strips, no central ornaments, no objects within center, keep corners readable when used at different aspect ratios.
Constraints: NO papers, no pins in the center, no writing, no letters, no numbers, no title plaque, no UI controls, no badges, no characters, no watermark. Complete panel visible, face-on without perspective. Polished game UI background bitmap.
